source_artifacts.role: Rust FFI declarations for the backend ABI
safe Rust facade over selected current backend calls
Metal and feature-gated CUDA backend build/link wiring
B300-capable safe wrapper versus direct C ABI smoke
M10.5c4c1 CUDA backend smoke contract checker
runtime route and B300 gate closure matrix
same-B300 current-C and Rust runtime benchmark closure

b300_rerun_commands.command: git archive HEAD | kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default exec -i ds4-rust-port-b300 -- tar -xf - -C /workspace/ds4 && kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default exec ds4-rust-port-b300 -- sh -lc 'set -e; cd /workspace/ds4; rustup default stable && CUDA_ARCH=native cargo test -p ds4-gpu --features cuda-backend --test backend_abi -- --nocapture'

kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default exec ds4-rust-port-b300 -- sh -lc 'set -e; cd /workspace/ds4; target=$(readlink -f /workspace/ds4/ds4flash.gguf); sha256sum tests/test-vectors/official.vec speed-bench/promessi_sposi.txt; python3 -m json.tool ds4-parity/baselines/bench/m0.6/logs/csv-summary.json >/dev/null'

git archive HEAD | kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default exec -i ds4-rust-port-b300 -- tar -xf - -C /workspace/ds4 && kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default exec ds4-rust-port-b300 -- sh -lc 'set -e; cd /workspace/ds4; CUDA_ARCH=native python3 ds4-parity/run_runtime_graph_bench.py --workdir /workspace/ds4 --model /workspace/ds4/ds4flash.gguf --output-dir /tmp/ds4-m109f-bench --write-summary /tmp/ds4-m109f-benchmark-closure.json --negative-test' && kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ds4-hou2-prod1.kubeconfig --context hou2-prod1 -n default cp ds4-rust-port-b300:/tmp/ds4-m109f-benchmark-closure.json ds4-parity/baselines/graph/m10.9f/runtime-benchmark-closure.json

operation_families.name: backend_lifecycle
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; current C/CUDA/Metal lifecycle remains the implementation
drift_policy: refresh when init, cleanup, quality, or memory-report ABI changes
rerun M10.5a and M10.5c4c1 checkers before replacement planning

operation_families.name: tensor_lifetime
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; Rust owns handle safety only, not tensor allocation kernels
drift_policy: refresh when tensor pointer, range, copy, read, write, or view ABI changes
rerun backend_abi on B300 before any tensor-lifetime replacement slice

operation_families.name: command_buffers
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; Rust guards command lifetime but current backend owns execution
drift_policy: refresh when command begin, flush, end, synchronize, or failure behavior changes
preserve command-boundary evidence from the M10.2 oracle

operation_families.name: model_mapping
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; model mapping and accelerator cache remain current-backend behavior
drift_policy: refresh when model-map range, fd, cache-range, or managed-KV decisions change
rerun model-map and B300 CUDA linkage checks before fixture capture

operation_families.name: embedding_and_indexer
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; embeddings, indexer scores, top-k, and masks stay current-backend until M12.4+
drift_policy: refresh when embedding/indexer signatures, top-k shape, or ratio-indexer semantics change
capture operation tensors in M12.2 before any replacement slice

operation_families.name: dense_norm_rope_kv
operation_families.model_requirement: model weights, activations, and KV tensors
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; dense, norm, RoPE, and KV kernels remain current-backend until tensor fixtures exist
drift_policy: refresh when projection, norm, RoPE, FP8/KV, or raw-cache signatures change
tie any output drift to M12.2 tensor fixtures and same-backend reruns

operation_families.name: compressor_attention
operation_families.model_requirement: model weights, raw KV, compressed KV, and mask tensors
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; compressor and attention kernels remain current-backend until tensor fixtures exist
drift_policy: refresh when compressor, prefill, decode attention, or output projection signatures change
preserve M10.9 official-vector, long-context, tool/server, and benchmark evidence

operation_families.name: routing_moe
operation_families.model_requirement: router logits, expert weights, and model offsets
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; routing, shared expert, and routed MoE kernels remain current-backend until tensor fixtures exist
drift_policy: refresh when router, hash routing, shared expert, routed MoE, add, or steering signatures change
M12.2 fixtures must record selected experts and weights before replacement

operation_families.name: hc_output
operation_families.model_requirement: HC state, output weights, routed/shared FFN outputs, and logits tensors
operation_families.claim_boundary: no-removal; HC/output kernels remain current-backend until tensor fixtures and route gates pass
drift_policy: refresh when HC split/expand/weighted-sum, shared-down, or output-head signatures change
preserve same-B300 benchmark and quality-gate evidence for route comparisons
